findings.problem: The 10-second deadline covers child.try_wait, then wait_with_output drains newly piped stdout/stderr without a deadline. Another concurrent fork may inherit those pipe writers until exec, even after the exact test child exits, so the output drain can escape the advertised bound. This is the same descriptor-inheritance mechanism demonstrated by the new controlled witness.
